meshify.mod.description: Select a region with /meshify start and /meshify end, then export it to OBJ + MTL + textures. Supports modded blocks, block entities, entities, and optional greedy-mesh UV baking for polygon reduction. Based on the pos2obj mod on CurseForge by usagi_san.
meshify.msg.hint: [Meshify] Export with /meshify export <name> [options…] (press Tab for options), or open the menu with /meshify gui
meshify.msg.pre_unloaded: [Meshify] %s chunk(s) in range are not loaded and will export as air — fly closer or raise your render distance
meshify.msg.pre_large: [Meshify] Large region (%s blocks): this will take a while. Progress is shown above the hotbar
meshify.msg.export_start: [Meshify] Exporting… (%s blocks, %s). Use /meshify cancel to stop
meshify.msg.done: [Meshify] Done in %s s: %s blocks, %s entities, %s faces
meshify.msg.saved: [Meshify] Saved to %s (click the path to open the folder)
meshify.msg.saved_hover: Click to open the export folder
meshify.msg.weld_summary: [Meshify] Optimize: %s → %s faces (removed %s degenerate, %s duplicate; weld grid 1/%s block)
meshify.error.no_selection: [Meshify] Set the region first with /meshify start and /meshify end
meshify.error.busy: [Meshify] An export is already running. Use /meshify cancel to stop it
meshify.error.world_changed: [Meshify] Export stopped: you left the world it was scanning
meshify.error.wrong_dimension: [Meshify] The selection belongs to %s — go back there or run /meshify clear
meshify.error.trim_empty: [Meshify] The selection is only air, so there is nothing to trim to
meshify.error.trim_unloaded: [Meshify] %s chunk(s) in the selection are not loaded, so trimming could cut off real blocks — fly closer or raise your render distance
meshify.opt.desc.atlas: Pack every texture into a single image (default)
meshify.opt.desc.bake: Merge faces and bake textures into new UVs (large polygon reduction)
meshify.opt.desc.weld: Weld vertices and remove degenerate/duplicate faces
meshify.opt.desc.cull: Aggressively cull faces hidden behind opaque neighbors
meshify.opt.desc.uv: Bake resolution: %s px per block face
meshify.opt.desc.uv_default: Bake resolution: %s px per block face (default)
meshify.gui.title: Meshify
meshify.gui.set_corner.tooltip: Uses the block you are looking at, or the one you are standing on
meshify.gui.full_height.tooltip: Stretch the region from the bottom of the world to the build limit
meshify.gui.trim.tooltip: Shrink the region to the blocks inside it, dropping the air around them
meshify.gui.name: Export name
meshify.gui.bad_amount: [Meshify] Enter how many blocks to move the side, 1 or more
